name: The Westin Edina Galleria
positioning: A Westin in Edina, directly connected to the Galleria shopping center and minutes from downtown Minneapolis, with a Stable House cocktail house and rotating on-property experiences
best_for: Shoppers who want to walk straight into the Galleria
Travelers who want a Twin Cities base with curated local experiences

facts.text: Southdale Center is just across the street.
The 50th & France district, with boutiques, artisan retailers and cafes, is moments away.
The hotel is minutes from downtown Minneapolis.
Every room is centered on the signature Westin Heavenly Bed.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio has Peloton bikes.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
Guests can book a private bonfire with s'mores in the courtyard.
The hotel offers rotating on-property experiences such as afternoon tea and local artist installations.
A personalized styling experience matches guests with partner stores to help find items.
Prelude bar showcases the Reserve Collection of select spirits, including one-of-a-kind bottles and limited-production batches.

highlights.text: The hotel is directly connected to the Galleria, with designer boutiques, luxury brands and specialty shops.
Each suite comes with a Lululemon Fitness Mirror programmed with workouts.
Weekend Wonders packages include Paisley Park tours, paddleboard yoga and igloo dining.
On-property activations have included turning the lobby into a ski chalet, pop-ups and tastings.
Stable House is an intimate cocktail house inspired by the sporting lodges of New England and the English countryside, with rich wood, worn leather, antique brass and crystal decanters.

considerations.text: The hotel is in suburban Edina, minutes from downtown Minneapolis rather than in it.
WhataHotel notes limited outdoor recreational spaces.
